answer_1.quote: We adopt the Large Language Model Personalization (LaMP) benchmark for our experiments, which consists of six public language model personalization tasks, including three text classification tasks ... and three text generation tasks (personalized news headline generation, scholarly title generation, and tweet paraphrasing).
answer_1.outputs: Generated headlines, titles, and paraphrased tweets

answer_2.quote: For personalized text generation, we adopt ROUGE-1 and ROUGE-L. For personalized text classification, we use accuracy and F1-score, and for product rating we use MAE and RMSE.
